source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Applying Troubleshooting and Preventive Measures under 9.2 as printed (PDF 128, printed 124).

blocks.text: When a security issue is found, troubleshooting helps determine its cause and how to fix it. Preventive measures include installing firewalls, antiviruses and anti-malware, updating software, changing passwords, or removing harmful files. In some cases, restoring data from backups may be necessary. Documenting the problem and the steps taken helps prevent it from happening again.
